title: Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25k Watermelon B / Strawberry B Gum Gum Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: This confectionery-style pair offers two takes on bubblegum sweetness. Watermelon B’ Gum blends juicy Watermelon with a soft candy note, while Strawberry B’ Gum adds a fuller berry tone to the same nostalgic base. Designed for use with the Hayati Ultra 25K Prefilled Pod Kit, each pack combines a 2ml prefilled pod with two 10ml auto-refilling containers so you can load both refills and switch on the device for quick changes. The plug-in format keeps handling simple and tidy. The mesh coil and 20mg Nic Salt ensure smooth MTL vapour, clear flavour and swift nicotine satisfaction from either candy-led profile. How to Set Up Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Pods Step 1 Remove all protective seals from the 2ml pod and both 10ml refill containers. Step 2 Click the 2ml pod into the mouthpiece module. Step 3 Align and click up to two 10ml auto-refilling containers into the mouthpiece. Step 4 Insert the assembled unit into the device. Step 5 Allow a short moment for the coil to saturate before vaping. ✅ You're all set!
